summary: Changes an earlier approval for water and sewer lines at 5047 John Hagar Road (Kingsley Park Phase 1, Revision 1). Metro may now give up about 75 feet of old sewer main, one fire hydrant and one manhole, and accept about 400 feet of new water main, about 471 feet and 1,015 feet of new sewer main, one fire hydrant, 12 manholes and easements. This is far less than the earlier approval.
